title: Link Proximity Snap Screen And Commit
description: Fix proximity connect at detail/micro LOD for rectangular nodes: use screen-space snap tolerance during drag; strict commit disk on pointer-up so node-center drops still use indirectConnect; keep tests green.
summary: Proximity link snap used world distance with d<tol, which shrinks the snap halo at high zoom and broke detail/micro drags toward rectangular handle anchors. Drag phase now uses screen-pixel distance to the anchor (HANDLE_HIT + LINK_EXTRA + handle radius×zoom) with inclusive <=. Pointer-up only commits proximityConnect when the cursor is within a tight screen disk (HANDLE_HIT + LINK_COMMIT_SNAP_TIGHT_PX + radius×zoom), otherwise the existing node-hit path runs so sole-handle drops on node centers still emit indirectConnect. Added regression test board_host_link_drag_snap_micro_zoom_rectangle_compatible_handles and set_micro_lod helper. cargo test -p elements_board --lib: 59 passed.
